name: Mobis Parts America PDC - Aurora IL

fieldNotes.site: Mobis Parts America Central Region PDC at 1705 Sequoia Dr, Aurora IL — confirmed by web research (Yellow Pages, Loc8NearMe, Chamber of Commerce) and by a 'MOBIS' sign visible on the building face in Street View. Standalone warehouse in a suburban Chicago-metro business park along I-88. Roster geocode moved 1385 m; the building was positively re-confirmed.
fieldNotes.truckGate: false — the property is entered from Sequoia Dr via an OPEN, ungated driveway (Street View 2024-04 shows no barrier arm, no sliding gate, no checkpoint). The dock yard wraps around to the building's east face via this open drive.
fieldNotes.guardShack: false — no staffed booth anywhere at the entrance or in the yard.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: East face of the Mobis building carries a dock-door bank with trailers backed in; counted ~34, placing it in the 25-50 band. Honest overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked along the east dock yard — modest drop activity, 10-25 stalls. Not a dedicated separate drop-yard lot, so dropYard = false.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The wrap-around dock-yard drive on the east side has room to stack 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Urban — built-up suburban Chicago-metro business park (Aurora) along I-88, wall-to-wall warehouses and office buildings; not farmland or open country.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: false — single standalone Mobis building; neighboring warehouses are separate properties.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: false — a single east dock bank handles ship and receive.
fieldNotes.railServed: false — no rail spur into the property.
fieldNotes.geofence: Center 41.7935,-88.3573 on the Mobis building; perimeter box encloses the building, its east dock yard and front parking.
